about: Where each colour in utils/config.py comes from. A string is a name in rnv-brand (TABLE.key, or one of its own constants, in engine/brand.py); an object is a value this application owns, with the reason. Edit this file, then run: python tools/sync_colors.py

GREY_E0.why: grey(14) on the ramp. Static light surfaces, a tab and a scrollbar track, that share pressed-light's hex without being a pressed state.

GREY_66.why: grey(6) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. Secondary and muted text on light.

GREY_88.why: grey(8) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. Muted text on dark; a scrollbar handle's hover on light.

GREY_55.why: grey(5) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. Disabled text and a checkbox edge on dark.

GREY_44.why: grey(4) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. The swatch preview's outline.

GREY_CC.why: grey(12) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. The light-mode border.

IMAGE_CANVAS_LIGHT.why: The image viewer's ground in light mode. It shares a hex with the register's gold text floor by coincidence, not by role.

CONTRAST_DEMO_BLACK_BG.why: Data, not chrome: the black the contrast demo tests against. It stays black whatever the brand does, or the demo loses its meaning.

CONTRAST_DEMO_WHITE_BG.why: Data, not chrome: the white the contrast demo tests against.

CONTRAST_DEMO_BLACK_FG.why: Data, not chrome: the contrast demo's black text.

CONTRAST_DEMO_WHITE_FG.why: Data, not chrome: the contrast demo's white text.

DEBUG_TEXT.why: The debug dimension label's terminal green, readable on anything. A development aid.

DEBUG_BG.why: The debug label's ground, semi-transparent black.

SELECTION_BOX_COLOR.why: The image viewer's selection rectangle, CSS yellow. No register value holds it.

SVG_EXPORT_BG.why: Data, not chrome: an exported palette's paper white. It does not follow the brand's white.

SVG_EXPORT_STROKE.why: Data, not chrome: an exported palette's ink black.

MISSING_HEX_PLACEHOLDER.why: Data: the deliberately wrong-looking black shown when a colour record has no hex.
